# Fixing LED Lightbar Wind Noise and Vibration

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Apply three Automotive trim protector fins focusing placement on the second fin from the top and two bottom ones. [t167]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Apply three fins of Automotive trim protector 'Edge Trim' to the lightbar.
2. Focus placement on the second fin from the top and the two bottom fins.

_Procedure reported by [t167]._

## Tools

- [Partial] Automotive trim protector (e.g., Edge Trim) [t167]

## Tips & gotchas

- This method breaks up harmonic resonance to reduce wind noise at speeds around 45 mph. [t167]
- The fins are subtle and may require close study to see on the bar. [t167]
